func forkEntry(record *enr.Record) (*pb.ENRForkID, error) {
    sszEncodedForkEntry := make([]byte, 16)

    err := record.Load(entry)
    if err != nil {
        return nil, err

```go
func (e *ENRForkID) UnmarshalSSZ(buf []byte) error {
    var err error
    size := uint64(len(buf))
    if size != 16 {
        return ssz.ErrSize
    }
    // ... fixed offsets into buf[0:4], buf[4:8], buf[8:16] ...
}
```
- Key: UnmarshalSSZ validates exact 16-byte size before accessing
- forkEntry() pre-allocates 16-byte buffer; enr.Record.Load fills it
- The buffer is fixed-size, so malformed ENR with wrong-size eth2 field would either fail enr.Load or be truncated/padded

func updateENR(node *enode.LocalNode, entry, next params.NetworkScheduleEntry) error {

        CurrentForkDigest: entry.ForkDigest[:],
        NextForkVersion:   next.ForkVersion[:],
        NextForkEpoch:     next.Epoch,
    }
    if entry.Epoch == next.Epoch {
        enrForkID.NextForkEpoch = params.BeaconConfig().FarFutureEpoch
    }
    // ...
    enc, err := enrForkID.MarshalSSZ()
    node.Set(forkEntry)
}
```
